snippet.title: Wandfall Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Descend into darkness. Uncover ancient secrets. Survive the fall.

Wandfall is a projectile-action roguelite where you grab a wizard, slap on a wand, and fight for ascension!

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3771950/Wandfall/

⚔️ Atmospheric arcade-style combat
💀 Varied foes and dynamic combat
✨ Ascension and power ups
🏛️ Ancient ruins and mysteries
